title: 第25章 死而无憾了第26章 五大宗门
slug: 合欢宗从照顾师弟道侣开始修仙
content_zh:
三个时辰后。
通天灵舟突然散发出了灵力波动。
“出发了！”
“名额满了吗？”
巨大的“通天灵舟”缓缓升空而起。
朝着远方的天空渐渐远去了。
宗门大殿广场上一些未上船的外门弟子一脸的懊恼。
为自己的怯弱而感到羞愧。
此时，在“通天灵舟”某个房间中。
“修行六十载，此番风景还是第一次看到吧。”
李蒙站在窗前，眺望着外面的山川美景。
回望六十载，人生过于无趣了。
他太喜欢修炼了。
六十载的人生中除了炼丹就是修炼。
从未离开过宗门，也从未外出历练过。
没想到临了自己会冒险前往最危险的“血色禁地”。
“咚咚咚！”
就在这时，房门突然被敲响了。
李蒙笑眯眯的看向了房门。
难道是袁师妹来了？

李蒙朝着房门走了过去。
只听“咔”的一声。
房门被从里面打开了。
看着门外一脸铁青的曲师叔，李蒙脸色一怔。
“曲……曲师叔？”
曲柔面无表情的进入了房间。
朝着李蒙一步步逼近。
李蒙连连后退。
曲柔扬手一挥。
房门“砰”的一声被关上了。
“你进入宗门六十载，去的最远的地方是宗门外的坊市，血色禁地是什么样的地方难道你不知？你究竟想要做什么？想要找个好地方安葬自己吗？”
房间中响起了曲柔那冷清的声音。
“那个……曲师叔，太近了，太近了！”
李蒙已经退无可退了。
他已经背靠在了窗台上。
面对曲师叔那冰冷的目光，李蒙心中一阵嘀咕。
曲师叔难道是在担心自己？
“跟我下船！”
曲柔伸出纤纤玉手抓住了李蒙的手。
拉着李蒙就要向外走去。

“曲师叔！”
content_en:
Three hours later.
The Tongtian Spirit Boat suddenly emitted spiritual power fluctuations.
"Let's go!"
"Is the quota full?"
The huge "Tongtian Spirit Boat" slowly rose into the sky.
Fading away towards the distant sky.
Some of the outer disciples in the square of the sect's main hall who had not yet boarded the boat looked annoyed.
Ashamed of my own cowardice.
At this time, in a certain room of "Tongtian Spirit Boat".
"After sixty years of practice, this is probably the first time I have seen this scenery."
Li Meng stood in front of the window, looking out at the beautiful mountains and rivers outside.
Looking back sixty years, life is too boring.
He likes practicing so much.
In my sixty years of life, apart from refining elixirs, I also practiced cultivation.
He has never left the sect and has never gone out for training.
I didn't expect that I would risk going to the most dangerous "bloody forbidden land".
"Dong dong dong!"
At this moment, there was a sudden knock on the door.
Li Meng looked at the door with a smile.
Could it be that Junior Sister Yuan is here?
Li Meng walked towards the door.
Just listen to a "click" sound.
The door was opened from the inside.
Looking at Uncle Qu with a livid face outside the door, Li Meng was startled.
"Uncle Qu...Uncle Qu?"
Qu Rou entered the room expressionlessly.
Approaching Li Meng step by step.
Li Meng stepped back repeatedly.
Qu Rou waved her hand.
The door was closed with a bang.
"You have been in the sect for sixty years, and the farthest place you have been is Fangshi outside the sect. Don't you know what kind of place the Bloody Forbidden Land is? What exactly do you want to do? Do you want to find a good place to bury yourself?"
Qu Rou's cold voice sounded in the room.
"That... Uncle Qu, it's too close, too close!"
Li Meng has no retreat.
He was already leaning against the window sill.
Facing Master Qu's cold gaze, Li Meng murmured in his heart.
Is Mr. Qu worried about himself?
"Get off the boat with me!"
Qu Rou stretched out her slender hand and grabbed Li Meng's hand.
He pulled Li Meng and walked out.
"Uncle Master Qu!"
